parameters.command: =mkdir -p /data/n8n_linkedin/output && cd /data/n8n_linkedin/python && python3 jobs_scraper.py -k "{{ $json.jobTitles }}" -l "{{ $('Parse Config').item.json.location }}" -n {{ $('Parse Config').item.json.maxJobs }} -t {{ $('Parse Config').item.json.timeRange }} 2>&1

=TITLE="{{ $('Loop Job Titles').item.json.jobTitles }}"
LOC="{{ $('Parse Config').item.json.location }}"
TIME="{{ $('Parse Config').item.json.timeRange }}"

case "$TIME" in
  "24h") SECS="86400" ;;
  "48h") SECS="172800" ;;
  "7d"|"week") SECS="604800" ;;
  *) SECS="172800" ;;
esac

FILE_TITLE=$(echo "$TITLE" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9 -]//g' | sed 's/[ -]\+/_/g')
FILE_LOC=$(echo "$LOC" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9 -]//g' | sed 's/[ -]\+/_/g')
FILE="/data/n8n_linkedin/python/${FILE_TITLE}__${FILE_LOC}_r${SECS}.json"

if [ -f "$FILE" ]; then
  cat "$FILE"
else
  echo '[]'
fi

=OUTPUT_FILE="{{ $json.outputFile }}"
RECORD=$(echo '{{ $json.recordBase64 }}' | base64 -d)

if [ -f "$OUTPUT_FILE" ] && [ -s "$OUTPUT_FILE" ]; then
  CURRENT=$(cat "$OUTPUT_FILE")
  echo "${CURRENT%]},$RECORD]" > "$OUTPUT_FILE"
else
  echo "[$RECORD]" > "$OUTPUT_FILE"
fi
echo "Saved match to $OUTPUT_FILE"

=OUTPUT_FILE="{{ $json.outputFile }}"
RECORD=$(echo '{{ $json.recordBase64 }}' | base64 -d)

if [ -f "$OUTPUT_FILE" ] && [ -s "$OUTPUT_FILE" ]; then
  CURRENT=$(cat "$OUTPUT_FILE")
  echo "${CURRENT%]},$RECORD]" > "$OUTPUT_FILE"
else
  echo "[$RECORD]" > "$OUTPUT_FILE"
fi
echo "Saved rejected to $OUTPUT_FILE"
